tasks.subject: research: verify the official XDG and host runtime-directory contract
tasks.description: Invoke: /research. Resolve the tight official question: how must an application distinguish missing or unavailable XDG runtime state from existing insecure state, including systemd and non-systemd hosts? Persist the sourced answer for solution confidence.

tasks.subject: blend-external: compare current peer-framework runtime-state patterns
tasks.description: Invoke: /blend-external. Target only runtime path resolution, advisory-vs-authority state, locking, recovery, and host portability in current gstack, Open GSD, GSD 2, and Superpowers; produce an ADOPT/MODIFY/SKIP proposal without importing code.

tasks.subject: design-tech: define the shared secure runtime-root and activation transaction
tasks.description: Invoke: /design-tech. Produce the system contract map, acceptance criteria, fallback security invariants, migration surface, and solution-confidence packet.

tasks.subject: explore-solutions: challenge the permanent runtime portability design
tasks.description: Invoke: /explore-solutions. Compare incident-only, centralized resolver, and authority-store redesign options; select the smallest reversible design that preserves fail-closed security.

tasks.subject: plan-changeset: freeze the WI-506 implementation manifest
tasks.description: Invoke: /plan-changeset. Bind every file, test, rollback, install step, and live replay to WI-506 acceptance criteria and the selected confidence decision.

tasks.subject: review-plan: adversarial host-portability and authority review
tasks.description: Invoke: /review-plan. Attack fallback trust boundaries, consumer completeness, activation ordering, rollback, and live-proof sufficiency before execution.

tasks.subject: execute-changeset: implement WI-506 with red-green fixtures
tasks.description: Invoke: /execute-changeset. Implement only the reviewed manifest using focused failing baselines, atomic state writes, and exact consumer migration.

tasks.subject: review-gate: framework hot-path correctness review
tasks.description: Invoke: /review-gate. Review the frozen diff for contract fidelity, scope, regression risk, test quality, and host compatibility; block landing on unresolved findings.

tasks.subject: review-exec: independent execution review of the frozen diff
tasks.description: Invoke: /review-exec. Independently attack missing-XDG, unsafe-XDG, symlink, permissions, partial activation, concurrent retry, and install-drift cases.

tasks.subject: review-security: threat-model runtime receipt and fallback authority
tasks.description: Invoke: /review-security. Prove fallback never converts insecure existing state into trusted authority and that all receipt paths remain user-private and canonical.

tasks.subject: audit-implementation: verify every consumer and acceptance invariant
tasks.description: Invoke: /audit-implementation. Reconcile the implementation, tests, map, plan, and ACs; pattern-scan for residual independent runtime-root policies.

tasks.subject: test-framework: focused runtime fixtures then full Tier-1
tasks.description: Invoke: /test-framework. Run the focused pre/post matrix, all affected validators, full Tier-1, and classify any untouched baseline failures without re-entering improve-framework.

tasks.subject: land-changeset: publish the reviewed WI-506 correction and receipts
tasks.description: Invoke: /land-changeset. Commit, push, open/review/merge the sanctioned PR, publish final-SHA receipts, and preserve unrelated worktrees and residue.

tasks.subject: verify-promotion: refresh installs and replay WI-496 without overrides
tasks.description: Invoke: /verify-promotion. Refresh all supported installations, prove zero drift, rerun missing-XDG ensure and loader commands with the original host environment, verify idempotence, and close WI-506 only on promoted evidence.
